item.title: 0.5.0-beta.7
item.description:
# Tiro public beta 7
This beta makes the Wireframe Board easier to keep nearby and share from.
- Pin the board when you want it to stay visible, or let it hide automatically when focus moves away. - Export a tight square around the artwork, or append its saved path to the text already on your clipboard. - Use distinct mobile, browser, and dotted frames, visible tool labels, Clear all, and the new Wireframe Board menu shortcut.
